digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria registry and reviewer prompts
propositions: Dual vocabulary ('success criteria' and 'acceptance criteria') in reviewer prompts is noise that conflates distinct rubric checks into pooled single bars, misleading the reviewing model

Textual substitution must rename 'Success Criteria' to 'Acceptance Criteria' across eleven specified locations in prompts and routing while preserving three deliberately excluded instances (T2's generic trial metrics language and definition-of-done wording)

Generated criteria guide must be regenerated from the updated prompts to eliminate downstream success-criteria vocabulary, carrying exactly one remaining match from T2's preserved pilot-metrics phrase
Editing criteria_routing.json rotates the regver stamp, invalidating outstanding plan-review attestations, but is safe only after ticket 1f32-f86e-8a51-4d8e's grandfathering mechanism has merged
Registry version computation must provably differ before and after the routing edit, captured at runtime without hardcoded literals
